title: Cover-up of retrieved craft and beings since 1947
summary: Robert Salas tells of Cover-up of retrieved craft and beings since 1947, about 1947-present at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: probably 47 there's been um an attempt to uh seriously cover up uh anything um

plain: A former US Air Force officer named Robert Salas, on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that since about 1947 there has been a serious effort in the United States to cover up anything to do with UFOs, including, as the story goes, crashed craft and beings recovered from them. If true, it would mean the government has kept its biggest secret for most of a century.
